author: inteldata
quote: If *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* (much like *GTA VI*) had been released running at 30 FPS, in digital-only format, and riddled with bugs, it would have been slammed with a 0/100 score on Metacritic. It is inexcusable that both the press and some fans are willing to overlook such glaring flaws in *GTA VI*.
